overclaims: Morris and colleagues proposed an AGI classification framework on June 5, 2024; using it here would add criteria absent from the passage [e1; marcus-this-one-important-fact-about-current-d4d5f8-o1].
checks.note: The excerpt is verbatim and the proposition and conditions are faithful. Axis, horizon and outcome match the agreed reviews. The rationale gets a date wrong: the e1 context shows the framework was first submitted on 4 Nov 2023 (v1), and 5 Jun 2024 is only when v4 was revised. Saying Morris et al. 'proposed' it on June 5, 2024 misstates the period. Suggested fix: 'in a paper first posted in November 2023 (version 4 dated June 5, 2024)'. The cited e1 fragment and its v4 dates are otherwise accurate.
